PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == /root/.claude/plans/* ]]; then BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE"); DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); DEST_DIR="/home/user/mxo-track/docs/superpowers/plans/conversation"; mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"; DEST="$DEST_DIR/${DATE}-${BASENAME}"; cp "$FILE" "$DEST" && cd /home/user/mxo-track && git add "$DEST" && git commit -m "docs: persist conversation plan ${DATE}-${BASENAME}" && git push; fi'
